# RPG Web Foundation

> Server-authoritative, grid-based (tile + turn) browser RPG themed on Solo Leveling. TypeScript monorepo: NestJS + Socket.IO server, Phaser + Vite client, shared Zod contracts (`@rpg/contracts`). Server decides all outcomes; client only renders and sends intents. Ranks E…SSS+ (9), MAX_LEVEL 200, 8 gate worlds. State is in-memory (no database yet) and the demo seeds players at Lv 100.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/walbarellos/sololeveling-rpg/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): read order, commands, do-not-read list, invariants, ADRs 1-13
- [Docs index](https://github.com/walbarellos/sololeveling-rpg/blob/HEAD/docs/INDEX.md): task-to-file router and source-of-truth table

## Reference (open only what the task needs)
- [Socket protocol](https://github.com/walbarellos/sololeveling-rpg/blob/HEAD/docs/protocol.md): all 26 client events and 14 server events with schema, handler and service links; 32 error codes
- [Domain map](https://github.com/walbarellos/sololeveling-rpg/blob/HEAD/docs/domain-map.md): services, constants, rank-exam table, worlds/NPCs/classes, verified gaps and risks
- [Contracts entry](https://github.com/walbarellos/sololeveling-rpg/blob/HEAD/packages/contracts/src/index.ts): schemas, `ClientEvents`, `ServerEvents`, `ServerErrorCode`
- [Progression formulas](https://github.com/walbarellos/sololeveling-rpg/blob/HEAD/packages/contracts/src/progression.ts): `RANK_CAP`, `expToNext`, `mobExp`, `statMult`
- [Gateway](https://github.com/walbarellos/sololeveling-rpg/blob/HEAD/apps/server/src/realtime/game.gateway.ts): Socket.IO handlers (transport only)
- [GameService](https://github.com/walbarellos/sololeveling-rpg/blob/HEAD/apps/server/src/domain/game.service.ts): orchestrator of all rules
